# Courses at CNAM

<details open>
  <summary> Introduction to functional data [(STA117)](https://cnam-idf.fr/unites/introduction-aux-donnees-fonctionnelles-sta117)<br>
  *CNAM, Paris* [2025 -]</summary>
* Preprocessing
* Descriptive statistics for functional data
* Explanatory statistics for functional data
* R software
 
 </details>  
 
 <details open>
   <summary> High-Dimensional Statistical Learning [(STA217)](https://www.cnam-paris.fr/choisir-ma-formation/par-discipline/apprentissage-statistique-en-grande-dimension-1551348.kjsp) <br>
    *CNAM, Paris* [2025 -] </summary>
    
* Functional principal components methods
* Functional data clustering methods
* Functional data regressions methods
* R software


</details>

<details open>
   <summary>  Time Series Modeling and Forecasting [(STA116)](https://cnam-idf.fr/unites/modelisation-et-prevision-des-series-chronologiques-sta116) <br>
    *CNAM, Paris* [2025 -] </summary>
    
* Regression models
* Time series decomposition: Exponential Smoothing—Simple, Double, Holt-Winters 
* Analysis of Trends and Seasonality 
* Modeling Stationary Series: AR, MA, ARMA. Estimation, Model Selection, and Forecasting. 
* Extension to non-stationary series: ARIMA and SARIMA. 


</details>

<details open>
   <summary> [Biostatistics](https://ecole-pasteur.cnam.fr/tronc-commun-du-mastere-de-sante-publique-126915.kjsp?RH=pasteur_ri&RF=pasteur_tronc) <br> *CNAM-Pasteur, Paris* [2023 - 2025]</summary>
-    Probability 
-    Statistical inference (estimator, bias, variance, convergence, central limit theorem, classical confidence intervals)
-    Statistical tests for 2 groups
-    Univariate and bivariate analysis

</details>

<details open>

*  Estimation : maximum likelihood, Fischer information, Cramer Rao bound

*  Tests of mean, variance and proportion 
*  Non-parametric statistics



</details>

</details>


<details open>

</details>

<details open>
